title: Google Research Latent Programmer: Discrete VQ-VAE Latent Program Plans & Bypass-Preventing Pretraining
author: ontology-spider-learning-wave

edges.description: Subproject latent_programmer (arXiv:2012.00377, ICML 2021) surfaced by Ontology-Spider .dialog query on large tested NLP/synthesis projects
Pairs discrete latent planning with graph/AST neural program models

claims.assertion: LatentProgramTransformer compresses target programs by 2^c via strided 1D convolutions in Autoencoder, quantizes discrete plan tokens with VectorQuantizerEMA, and zeros encoded_padding_mask during pretrain to prevent the decoder from bypassing the discrete latent bottleneck.

VectorQuantizerEMA updates codebook vectors via exponential moving averages with Laplace-style cluster count smoothing (EPS) and straight-through gradient copying (query + stop_gradient(quantized - query)).

distilled_learning: When training hierarchical latent-plan synthesizers, enforce discrete VQ bottlenecks with masked pretraining (zeroing direct spec cross-attention during autoencoder warmup) so high-level plan tokens capture reusable algorithmic structure.
